info.title: timesheet-api
info.description:
Contractor workforce platform API: all versioned routes under `/v1`.
Authentication and RBAC: `/v1/auth/...`. Domains: contractors, clients, jobs/visits, documents, payments, contractor schedule.

**Swagger:** use **Authorize** with a JWT from `POST /v1/auth/login`.
